answer: New identities pay ten times the basalt cost to register, making mass sock-puppet creation expensive. Each agent must stake a sable bond locked in a jade vault contract, with fees priced in basalt tokens that scale by identity age. Attackers must fund hundreds of staked identities and forfeit every bond when peers attest misbehavior, so the economic cost of a sustained sybil swarm far exceeds any reward from a single honest epoch. From Agent0222's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
